Akali.combo: Wait hidden in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then emerge and land a surprise basic attack. When Akali starts a retaliatory basic attack, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart, land one or two more basic attacks with Teemo E Toxic Shot, then retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish her off, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along her escape route.
Akali.fight: After landing one attack, the poison keeps ticking, so use Teemo W Move Quick to create distance. Teemo Q Blinding Dart cannot stop Akali’s abilities, so use it when she retaliates with a basic attack.
Akali.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to withstand her early damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Akali deals mostly magic damage, and Teemo has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. Since you are facing an assassin, move Zhonya's Hourglass earlier between core items, and add penetration when increasing your damage to account for Akali’s high magic resistance.
Akali.escape: If you dodge the first projectile from Akali E Shuriken Flip, try to trade while she has one fewer way to close the gap. Do not go deep just because Akali W Twilight Shroud or Akali E Shuriken Flip is down. Look for a window before Akali R Perfect Execution is back and when her other mobility tools are also down.
Akali.laning: Use your range and Teemo E Toxic Shot to land one basic attack at a time and back off, building a health and CS lead during windows when Akali’s ultimate is unavailable. Prioritize dodging the first projectile from Akali E Shuriken Flip. If you have pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes, then continue trading.
Akali.phase: In the mid game, control paths with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap, and look for windows when Akali R Perfect Execution is unavailable. In the late game, fragile Teemo has trouble standing in the front, so prepare the area where you will fight in advance.
Akali.teamfight: Before the fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap along Akali’s approach and escape routes and around the objective. When the fight begins, apply poison from the back with basic attacks carrying Teemo E Toxic Shot, then back off. If Akali dives in, use Zhonya's Hourglass while the mushrooms and poison you placed earlier deal damage.
Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first projectile from Akali E Shuriken Flip. If it hits and marks you, the second dash will follow even if you run away, and you cannot dodge the first dash from Akali R Perfect Execution by walking. Also watch out for the slow from Akali Q Five Point Strike and her stealth in Akali W Twilight Shroud.

Riven.laning: Against melee Riven, repeat trades where you use your range and Teemo E Toxic Shot to land one basic attack and back off. Don’t overextend while Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor are available. If you’ve pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes first, then continue trading.
Riven.build: Play safe early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Riven’s main damage is physical, so build armor first.
Riven.combo: Hide in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then step out for an ambush basic attack. When Riven starts a retaliatory basic attack, hit her with Teemo Q Blinding Dart and apply the poison from Teemo E Toxic Shot with one or two basic attacks, then retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish her off, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap onto Riven’s escape route.
Riven.escape: Don’t engage just because Riven has used Q Broken Wings once. Take a short trade during the window when Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor are down and Riven W Ki Burst has also been used. Create distance with Teemo W Move Quick before Riven can close in again.
Riven.fight: Attack briefly when Riven uses Q Broken Wings to clear minions. Land one basic attack with Teemo E Toxic Shot, then back off, and use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Riven starts a retaliatory basic attack. Teemo Q Blinding Dart only negates basic attacks, so don’t stay close expecting it to block Riven’s abilities too.
Riven.phase: From the mid game on, control chokepoints with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. You’re fragile in late-game head-on team fights, so place traps beforehand and attack from the backline.
Riven.teamfight: Place Teemo R Noxious Trap ahead of time where a fight is likely and along Riven’s engage and escape routes. Once the fight starts, apply the poison from Teemo E Toxic Shot with basic attacks from the backline, and hit Riven with Teemo Q Blinding Dart when she retaliates with a basic attack. If Riven has activated R Blade of the Exile, create distance.
Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor are dashes; Riven Q Broken Wings also knocks you up, and Riven W Ki Burst stuns. Move away as soon as you see her first dash. When Riven activates R Blade of the Exile, her attack damage and range increase, and her finishing damage based on missing health becomes dangerous, so keep your distance until it ends.

Malphite.watch: Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows Teemo, so don’t start a trade right after it hits. Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash that can knock up multiple people, so when Malphite’s position is unknown, don’t group with allies near a wall or brush. Teemo Q Blinding Dart works against Malphite W Thunderclap’s empowered basic attack, but it can’t stop Malphite’s abilities.
Malphite.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against Malphite Q Seismic Shard, Malphite E Ground Slam, and Malphite R Unstoppable Force, which are his main sources of damage.
Malphite.combo: Hide in a brush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then come out and break Malphite P Granite Shield with a basic attack. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Malphite retaliates with an empowered basic attack. Land one or two more attacks with Teemo E Toxic Shot, then escape with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish him, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap where he will retreat.
Malphite.escape: The moment after Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down is your chance to go in.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then briefly harass with basic attacks that apply Teemo E Toxic Shot. Keep the poison damage going to prevent the shield from regenerating, and use Teemo Q Blinding Dart against Malphite W Thunderclap’s empowered basic attack. Don’t start a fight right after Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you.
Malphite.laning: You can’t dodge Malphite Q Seismic Shard from behind minions, so don’t stay in its range for long. If you’ve pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and brushes, then continue harassing.
Malphite.phase: In the late game, Teemo is squishy and has difficulty standing directly in a head-on team fight, so prepare the place where you’ll fight ahead of time.
Malphite.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force doesn’t knock up multiple people at once. Before a fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap on Malphite’s approach and retreat paths; once it starts, apply poison from behind with attacks that apply Teemo E Toxic Shot. Focus your retaliation right after Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down.

Aatrox.escape: Right after you make Aatrox use E Umbral Dash, you have a window to close the distance and attack. If you are caught by Aatrox W Infernal Chains, do not engage; use Teemo W Move Quick to leave its area immediately. Also retreat while Aatrox R World Ender is active and wait for its duration to end.
Aatrox.build: Aatrox deals mostly physical damage, and Teemo has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to withstand him. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots and prioritize armor. If a duel drags on and the healing from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance, E Umbral Dash, and R World Ender becomes a problem, build resistances first, then consider Grievous Wounds.
Aatrox.combo: Wait hidden in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then emerge and land a surprise basic attack. When Aatrox starts a retaliatory basic attack, hit him with Teemo Q Blinding Dart, land one or two more basic attacks, then retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish him off, attack with Teemo Q Blinding Dart, then a basic attack with Teemo E Toxic Shot, and throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along Aatrox’s escape route.
Aatrox.fight: Right after Aatrox uses his empowered basic attack from P Deathbringer Stance on a minion, land one basic attack with Teemo E Toxic Shot and back off. When Aatrox starts a retaliatory basic attack, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart to nullify it. Right after Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down, you have a chance to close the distance and attack, but stop fighting and create distance when Aatrox R World Ender is active.
Aatrox.laning: Early on, keep your distance and farm without giving Aatrox a kill. If you have pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes to guard against ganks, then continue trading.
Aatrox.phase: In the mid game, Teemo controls routes with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. In the late game, Teemo is fragile, so do not stand on the frontline in a head-on teamfight; prepare the area where the fight will happen in advance.
Aatrox.teamfight: Place Teemo R Noxious Trap in advance along the approach and escape routes near where a teamfight is expected. Before an objective fight, use your trap charges on nearby paths, then attack from the back with basic attacks carrying Teemo E Toxic Shot when the fight begins. Do not accept a head-on duel while Aatrox R World Ender is active.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is his main source of damage and can knock you up, so when you see the cast animation, move beyond the blade-tip area or inward past it. Teemo Q Blinding Dart only blocks basic attacks, so it cannot stop Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, use Teemo W Move Quick to leave its area immediately before you are pulled in.

Olaf.phase: Olaf is strongest early, so don’t give up a kill and keep your distance with your range advantage. Olaf becomes relatively weaker late, but Teemo is also squishy in head-on teamfights, so prepare your position ahead of time.
Olaf.build: Early on, survive with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Olaf deals mostly physical damage, and Teemo has relatively low armor, so build armor first. However, armor can’t reduce the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing, so build up your total health too.
Olaf.combo: Hide in a brush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then come out and apply Teemo E Toxic Shot’s poison with an attack. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Olaf starts retaliating with attacks, land one or two more attacks, then disengage with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish him, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along Olaf’s retreat path.
Olaf.escape: Move opposite the direction where Olaf Q Undertow’s axe lands to prevent him from retrieving it, then go in briefly. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance and let its duration run out; use the slow from Teemo R Noxious Trap after it ends. Olaf has no skill that creates distance on his own, but don’t overcommit to a chase just because health is low.
Olaf.fight: Prepare Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare’s invisibility in a brush, then start the trade with a surprise attack. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Olaf starts retaliating with attacks, apply poison, then escape with Teemo W Move Quick. When Olaf’s health has decreased, his attack speed and lifesteal increase, so don’t stay close and fight for long.
Olaf.laning: Make use of your range and Teemo E Toxic Shot’s poison to land one attack at a time and back off. Move opposite the direction where Olaf Q Undertow’s axe lands so he can’t retrieve it. If you’ve pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and brushes first, then continue trading.
Olaf.teamfight: Before a fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap on Olaf’s approach and retreat paths and around objectives. When the fight starts, apply poison with attacks from behind, and use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Olaf starts retaliating with attacks. During Olaf R Ragnarok, don’t rely on movement impairments; create distance.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow slows and reduces armor, so move opposite the direction where the axe lands to prevent him from retrieving it. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage that armor can’t reduce, so create distance when health is low. When Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don’t rely on movement impairments; get away so being hit by attacks doesn’t extend its duration.

Yone.build: The available information doesn’t specify a starting item against Yone, so there isn’t a specific item to recommend first. Yone Q Mortal Steel deals physical damage, while Yone P Way of the Hunter deals magic damage, so consider both resistances instead of building only one. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that only increase your health.
Yone.combo: When the whirlwind from Yone Q Mortal Steel isn’t ready, ambush him from the brush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then come out and apply Teemo E Toxic Shot’s poison with a basic attack. If Yone retaliates with a basic attack, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart, hit him one or two more times, then use Teemo W Move Quick to get away. To finish, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along Yone’s retreat route.
Yone.escape: Treat the time after Yone R Fate Sealed is down as an opportunity to engage. Even then, Yone can catch you again if Yone E Soul Unbound and the whirlwind from Yone Q Mortal Steel are still available, so confirm those tools are down or that the whirlwind stacks have disappeared before taking a short trade.
Yone.fight: When the whirlwind stacks from Yone Q Mortal Steel disappear, land one basic attack empowered by Teemo E Toxic Shot, then back away. When Yone starts a retaliatory basic attack, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart, and if he dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, use Teemo W Move Quick’s active effect to create distance.
Yone.laning: If Yone is hitting minions with Yone Q Mortal Steel to prepare a whirlwind, stop pressuring him and back away until the stacks disappear. If you’ve pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and brush, then continue trading.
Yone.phase: In the mid game, control routes with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. In late-game head-on team fights, fragile Teemo should not stand in front.
Yone.teamfight: Before a fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap along Yone’s engage and retreat routes and around objectives. Spread out so Yone W Spirit Cleave doesn’t hit multiple allies, and check your position in the formation, keeping in mind that Yone R Fate Sealed moves him behind the last champion along its path. Once the fight starts, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot’s poison with basic attacks from the backline, and time Teemo Q Blinding Dart with Yone’s basic attacks.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare a whirlwind, keep your distance until the stacks disappear. Yone E Soul Unbound and Yone R Fate Sealed close the gap, and Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies it hits, so avoid its path. Teemo Q Blinding Dart only blocks basic attacks, so don’t try to endure Yone’s abilities thinking it can stop them.

Aurora.teamfight: Before the fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap along Aurora’s approach and escape routes and around the objective. When the fight begins, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with basic attacks from the back. If Aurora uses a mobility ability to engage and no one is killed, take that as a chance to act. If an ally is killed, Aurora W Across the Veil’s cooldown may reset, so do not leave a low-health ally behind when retreating.
Aurora.build: Aurora deals mostly magic damage, and Teemo has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Aurora.combo: Ambush from a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then emerge with a basic attack and follow with Teemo Q Blinding Dart and one or two basic attacks. If Aurora retaliates or hits you with Aurora Q Twofold Hex, retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish her off, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with a basic attack, then throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along Aurora’s escape route.
Aurora.escape: Engage when Aurora W Across the Veil, Aurora E The Weirding, and Aurora R Between Worlds are down. If Aurora has only used one mobility ability, she can escape with her remaining mobility abilities, so do not rush the chase. If you have been hit by Aurora Q Twofold Hex and the curse remains, or your health is low, choose to disengage instead of engaging.
Aurora.fight: Ambush from a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then trade briefly by applying Teemo E Toxic Shot with a basic attack. If Aurora approaches to retaliate, use Teemo W Move Quick to retreat, and do not stay close while waiting for the recall damage from Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If only one of Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding is down, stay aware of her other mobility ability.
Aurora.laning: Repeat trades by applying Teemo E Toxic Shot with one basic attack, then backing off. Teemo Q Blinding Dart only blocks basic attacks, so do not save it to block Aurora’s ability damage. If you have pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes first, then continue trading.
Aurora.phase: Early on, Teemo trades briefly with basic attacks and Teemo E Toxic Shot, but is at a disadvantage if his health drops while affected by Aurora Q Twofold Hex. In the mid game, control side lanes and travel routes with Teemo R Noxious Trap, and look for a window before Aurora R Between Worlds is back. In late-game head-on teamfights, Teemo is fragile, so contribute with traps placed in advance and poison applied from the back instead of fighting up front.
Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, it damages you again when recalled, and the damage increases the more health you have lost. If you are cursed, move out of the line connecting you to Aurora, and if your health is low, retreat before the recall. Leave before Aurora R Between Worlds expands to avoid being slowed when entering or leaving the area.

Yorick.escape: After Yorick E Mourning Mist misses, Teemo has a chance to step forward and start harassing with basic attacks. If Yorick has also used Yorick W Dark Procession, he has no skill to create distance, so Teemo can look for an opening to engage.
Yorick.build: Use Cloth Armor to hold on early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against the physical damage from Yorick Q Last Rites and the ghouls.
Yorick.combo: Use Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare to become stealthed in the brush, then come out and apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with a basic attack. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Yorick retaliates with a basic attack, hit him one or two more times, then use Teemo W Move Quick to get away. To finish, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along Yorick’s retreat route.
Yorick.fight: After dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, step forward to land one basic attack empowered by Teemo E Toxic Shot, then back away. When Yorick tries to retaliate with a basic attack using Yorick Q Last Rites, hit him with Teemo Q Blinding Dart.
Yorick.laning: Don’t fight near graves Yorick has built up, and clear the ghouls first when they appear. Push the lane so Yorick can’t clear the wave on his side, but after pushing, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and brush, then keep poking.
Yorick.phase: In the mid game, watch Yorick’s side lane pressure while controlling paths with Teemo R Noxious Trap. In late-game head-on team fights, Teemo is fragile, so don’t stand in front.
Yorick.teamfight: Before a fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap around objectives and along Yorick’s engage and retreat routes. Once the fight starts, apply poison from the backline with basic attacks empowered by Teemo E Toxic Shot, and use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Yorick tries to retaliate with a basic attack.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows and marks you and also reduces your armor, so dodge the arc of the incoming projectile. If you’re trapped in Yorick W Dark Procession, break the wall with basic attacks, and if ghouls and the Maiden of the Mist are on you, create distance from Yorick himself.

Camille.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Camille’s main damage is physical, so prioritize armor, but armor cannot reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol.
Camille.combo: Hide with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare in a bush, then emerge and apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with a basic attack. When Camille retaliates with an empowered basic attack from Camille Q Precision Protocol, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart, land one or two basic attacks, then retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish her off, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along Camille’s escape route.
Camille.escape: After Camille E Hookshot is down, you have a chance to approach, but you can be caught again if Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is still available. Look to trade when both mobility abilities are down and Camille P Adaptive Defenses’ shield has been removed.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading right after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates its shield; once the shield has been removed, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with a basic attack and back off. Do not use Teemo Q Blinding Dart early; time it for when Camille’s empowered basic attack from Q Precision Protocol comes in. When Camille approaches, use Teemo W Move Quick to create distance.
Camille.laning: Stand away from walls and among minions to reduce Camille E Hookshot’s engage angle. Harass with basic attacks and Teemo E Toxic Shot to pressure Camille’s farming before she gets her first core item. If you have pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes, then continue trading.
Camille.phase: In the mid game, control routes with mushrooms while making sure not to leave a side lane open for Camille to quickly take down a turret. In late-game head-on teamfights, fragile Teemo should use mushrooms placed in advance instead of standing up front.
Camille.teamfight: Place Teemo R Noxious Trap in advance where a teamfight will happen and around the objective, covering Camille’s approach and escape routes. When the fight begins, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with basic attacks from the back, and use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Camille’s empowered basic attack from Q Precision Protocol comes in.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot uses walls to engage from a distance and stun you, so stand away from walls and avoid her hookshot engage. Once trapped by Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum, it is difficult to escape, so creating distance before Camille reaches you is important.

Chogath.build: Cho'Gath deals mostly magic damage, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and build magic resistance. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Resistance does not work against the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast, and Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes scales with maximum health, so be careful about building only health.
Chogath.combo: Hide in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then emerge and apply Teemo E Toxic Shot’s poison with a surprise basic attack. When Cho'Gath starts a retaliatory basic attack, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart, land one or two more basic attacks, then retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish him off, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along Cho'Gath’s escape route.
Chogath.escape: Cho'Gath has no mobility ability, so pressure him right after he uses Cho'Gath Q Rupture on the wave or misses it. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream is also down, go in briefly with less concern about its frontal silence. When both abilities are available, keep your distance because you can be caught and hit by follow-up attacks.
Chogath.fight: Repeat trades by applying Teemo E Toxic Shot’s poison with basic attacks from outside Cho'Gath Q Rupture’s range, then backing off. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Cho'Gath starts a retaliatory basic attack, but remember that Blinding Dart cannot block his abilities. After dodging Cho'Gath Q Rupture, use Teemo W Move Quick to find an angle and apply brief pressure.
Chogath.laning: Pressure Cho'Gath early with your range and Teemo E Toxic Shot to limit his chance to scale. Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes pierces minions, so step out of the line when Cho'Gath basic attacks. If you have pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes, then continue trading.
Chogath.phase: In the mid game, play the side lane and control paths with Teemo R Noxious Trap. Cho'Gath gets stronger as the game goes on, and Teemo has trouble fighting directly in late-game head-on teamfights, so prepare the fighting area in advance.
Chogath.teamfight: Before the fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap around the objective and along Cho'Gath’s approach and escape routes. When the fight begins, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot’s poison with basic attacks from the back, and dodge sideways when the marker for Cho'Gath Q Rupture appears. Watch out for the frontal area of Cho'Gath W Feral Scream and the range of Cho'Gath R Feast when your health is low.
Chogath.watch: When you see the ground marker for Cho'Gath Q Rupture, dodge sideways immediately. If you are silenced head-on by Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, you cannot use Teemo W Move Quick, so do not fight up front for long. If your health is at or below half, create distance to watch out for the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast.

Darius.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Darius’s main damage is physical, so prioritize armor, but keep in mind that armor cannot block the penetration from Darius E Apprehend or the true damage from Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Darius.combo: Hide in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then emerge and land a basic attack. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Darius retaliates with a basic attack. Land one or two more basic attacks, then retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish him off, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart and basic attacks to apply poison, then throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along Darius’s escape route.
Darius.escape: Only move forward to trade when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. A window when Darius R Noxian Guillotine is down is also an opportunity to engage. Save Teemo W Move Quick to respond to Darius E Apprehend, and end the fight as soon as bleed stacks start building.
Darius.fight: Repeat trades by landing one basic attack with Teemo E Toxic Shot from outside Darius E Apprehend’s range, then backing off. When Darius starts a retaliatory basic attack, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart and create distance with Teemo W Move Quick. Harass again after Darius E Apprehend misses or immediately after he uses Darius Q Decimate to clear minions.
Darius.laning: Hide in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare to set up a surprise attack, but do not walk into Darius E Apprehend’s range. Apply poison with one basic attack and back off to avoid an extended fight. If you have pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes, then continue trading.
Darius.phase: In the mid game, control paths with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. In late-game head-on teamfights, Teemo is fragile, so do not stand up front.
Darius.teamfight: Place Teemo R Noxious Trap in advance where a fight is expected, filling the enemy’s approach and escape routes. When the fight begins, apply poison with basic attacks from the back and stay outside Darius E Apprehend’s range. Fully disengage to avoid staying in the fight with several bleed stacks and being killed by Darius R Noxian Guillotine.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, he can follow up with a basic attack, Darius W Crippling Strike, and Darius Q Decimate, so harass from outside E’s range. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up, create distance to drop them, and move outside the blade’s range when you see Darius Q Decimate. When several bleed stacks are on you, get completely outside the range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine.

DrMundo.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Prioritize armor against Dr. Mundo’s main damage, and if his healing makes the duel drag on, consider Grievous Wounds afterward.
DrMundo.combo: Hide with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare in a bush, then apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with a surprise basic attack. When Dr. Mundo retaliates with a basic attack, hit him with Teemo Q Blinding Dart, land one or two more basic attacks, then retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish him off, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap where Dr. Mundo will retreat.
DrMundo.escape: Immediately after Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw is blocked by a minion or passes by, you have a chance to approach. Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so trade briefly then, but do not chase if Dr. Mundo has activated R Maximum Dosage.
DrMundo.fight: Ambush from a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with a basic attack, and trade briefly. When Dr. Mundo retaliates with a basic attack, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart, then retreat with Teemo W Move Quick after applying poison. Look to finish him off during a window when Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is down.
DrMundo.laning: Repeat trades by applying poison to nearby Dr. Mundo with one basic attack at a time, then backing off. Block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw with minions, and if a canister is on the ground after a trade, step on it while retreating to stop his healing. If you have pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes, then continue harassing.
DrMundo.phase: In the mid game, control paths with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. In late-game head-on teamfights, Teemo is fragile, so do not stand up front and make use of traps placed in advance.
DrMundo.teamfight: Place Teemo R Noxious Trap in advance around objectives where a fight is expected and along Dr. Mundo’s approach and escape routes. When the fight begins, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with basic attacks from the back, and use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Dr. Mundo threatens you with a basic attack. Do not spend time trying to kill him while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw only hits the first target, so use minions as cover to dodge it. Nullify Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma’s empowered basic attack by timing Teemo Q Blinding Dart as that attack starts. If Dr. Mundo has activated R Maximum Dosage, stop chasing, accounting for his healing and increased movement speed.

Fiora.build: Start with Cloth Armor to withstand her early damage, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Fiora’s main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. Resistance does not affect the true damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance or Fiora R Grand Challenge, and if the duel drags on, build resistances first, then consider Grievous Wounds.
Fiora.combo: Hide with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare in a bush, then emerge and apply poison with a basic attack. When Fiora W Riposte is down and she starts a retaliatory basic attack, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart, land one or two basic attacks, then retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish her off, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along Fiora’s escape route.
Fiora.escape: Right after Fiora Q Lunge is down, you have a window to close the distance. If Fiora W Riposte is available, do not use Teemo Q Blinding Dart first; start trading after Riposte is down. Once the trade is over, disengage with Teemo W Move Quick.
Fiora.fight: Use the moment right after Fiora Q Lunge is down to manage distance and trade. Land one basic attack with Teemo E Toxic Shot, then back off; when Fiora starts a retaliatory basic attack, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart. Blinding Dart only nullifies basic attacks, so do not treat it as a way to stop Fiora Q Lunge itself.
Fiora.laning: Stand opposite the marked vital to narrow Fiora Q Lunge’s engage angle. Use your range and Teemo E Toxic Shot to hit once at a time and back off, but do not overextend chasing Fiora after a short trade. If you have pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes, then continue trading.
Fiora.phase: Early on, use Cloth Armor to withstand Fiora’s physical damage and trade briefly.
Fiora.teamfight: Before a fight breaks out, place Teemo R Noxious Trap along Fiora’s approach and escape routes. After it starts, apply poison from the back with basic attacks carrying Teemo E Toxic Shot. If you are hit by Fiora R Grand Challenge, stay by a wall so you do not expose all four vitals.
Fiora.watch: Fiora Q Lunge can close in toward a vital, so stand opposite the vital to narrow her engage angle. Fiora W Riposte blocks attacks and strikes back, so move sideways when using Teemo Q Blinding Dart to avoid Riposte’s hitbox. If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, stay by a wall so you do not expose all four vitals.

Gangplank.build: Early on, use Cloth Armor to withstand the physical damage from Gangplank Q Parrrley and Gangplank E Powder Keg. Choose Plated Steelcaps and build armor first. Resistance does not reduce the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire or Gangplank R Cannon Barrage, so consider your total health as well.
Gangplank.combo: Stealth in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then emerge and apply Teemo E Toxic Shot's poison with a basic attack. When Gangplank starts a retaliatory basic attack, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart, land one or two more basic attacks, then retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish him off, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along Gangplank's retreat path.
Gangplank.escape: Engage right after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed or destroyed, when there are no primed kegs nearby. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, look for a window when he can't easily remove Teemo Q Blinding Dart's effect. Gangplank has no skill that creates distance on its own, so deal brief damage when you have an opening and retreat with Teemo W Move Quick.
Gangplank.fight: Trade right after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed or a keg is destroyed. Ambush from a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot's poison with a basic attack, then use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Gangplank starts a retaliatory basic attack. Don't stay in close for long; retreat with Teemo W Move Quick.
Gangplank.laning: Build armor before Gangplank Q Parrrley keeps chipping away at your health. Repeatedly apply poison with a basic attack and back off as soon as Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed; stop trading if a primed keg is nearby. If you've pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes before applying pressure.
Gangplank.phase: Early on, use armor to withstand poke from Gangplank Q Parrrley and look for the moment just after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed. In the mid game, control routes with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. Don't put yourself on the front line in late-game head-on teamfights.
Gangplank.teamfight: Before a fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap along the approach and retreat routes to the expected fight area. Before an objective fight, fill the area with traps and watch whether Gangplank R Cannon Barrage has been used to choose when to fight. Once the fight starts, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot's poison with basic attacks from the back line.
Gangplank.watch: Stay out of the area when Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed or two kegs overlap. Destroy kegs from outside their blast radius, and remember that Teemo Q Blinding Dart cannot block Gangplank Q Parrrley or Gangplank E Powder Keg.

Garen.build: Early on, hold out with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment deal most of their damage as physical damage, so build armor first. However, resistance can't reduce the true damage from Garen R Demacian Justice.
Garen.combo: If Garen Q Decisive Strike has been fully spent and Garen E Judgment is down, stealth in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then emerge and land an ambush basic attack. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart as Garen retaliates with a basic attack, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot's poison with one or two more basic attacks, then retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. If Garen W Courage is active, delay your combo by half a beat instead of unleashing it right when its shield appears.
Garen.escape: Garen has no mobility skill, so engage when Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered attack has been used and Garen E Judgment is down. Don't engage while Garen Q Decisive Strike is active or Garen E Judgment is spinning. Retreat with Teemo W Move Quick after trading.
Garen.fight: Trade briefly immediately after Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered basic attack is used on a minion or is fully spent. Land a basic attack with Teemo E Toxic Shot, then back off; use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Garen starts his retaliatory basic attack to block it. Teemo Q Blinding Dart can't stop Garen E Judgment, so create distance while it's spinning.
Garen.laning: Early on, use your range and Teemo E Toxic Shot to poke with one basic attack at a time and deny Garen room to build up comfortably. If you've pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes before continuing to apply pressure, to prepare for a gank. Only try a bush ambush after Garen E Judgment is down.
Garen.phase: From the mid game on, Teemo controls routes with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. Garen gets stronger as Garen W Courage's stacks build, so the matchup becomes less favorable over time. Teemo is fragile, so don't stand on the front line in late-game front-to-back fights.
Garen.teamfight: Before a fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap around objectives and along Garen's approach and retreat routes. Once the fight starts, attack from the back line with basic attacks carrying Teemo E Toxic Shot, and don't stay in range of Garen E Judgment's spin for long. If Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered attack approaches, block it with Teemo Q Blinding Dart.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike's empowered basic attack silences, and Garen E Judgment is dangerous the longer you stay close. Don't approach first while Garen Q Decisive Strike is active; when Garen E Judgment starts, leave its range with Teemo W Move Quick. If your health is below half, stay out of Garen R Demacian Justice's range, as it deals true damage based on your missing health.

Gnar.build: Early on, hold out with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Gnar's main damage is physical and Teemo has low armor, so build armor first. Remember that armor alone can't block the magic damage and max-health damage from Gnar W Hyper / Wallop.
Gnar.combo: Stealth in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then emerge and apply poison with a basic attack. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart as Gnar retaliates with a basic attack, follow with one or two more basic attacks, then retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish him off, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart and a poisoned basic attack, then throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along Gnar's retreat path.
Gnar.escape: The moment after you make Gnar use E Hop / Crunch is your chance to close the gap. Immediately after Mega Gnar returns to Mini Gnar, he can't transform again for a while, so look for an engage then. Conversely, create distance with Teemo W Move Quick if Gnar is close to transforming into Mega Gnar or you're at an angle where Gnar R GNAR! could knock you into a wall.
Gnar.fight: Don't take Mini Gnar's ranged poke unnecessarily. Close the gap right after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is used. Stealth in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, ambush with a basic attack to apply Teemo E Toxic Shot's poison, then use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Gnar starts a retaliatory basic attack. Don't fight Mega Gnar head-on for long; look for the window just after he returns to Mini Gnar, when he can't transform again.
Gnar.laning: When you're at a disadvantage, stay near your turret to farm and watch Gnar's transformation cycle so you aren't constantly exposed to Mini Gnar's range. Move out of the path of Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss to make it harder for Gnar to catch the boomerang, and trade with one poisoned basic attack before backing off. If you've pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes first to prepare for a gank.
Gnar.phase: Early on, Mini Gnar pokes from range, so Teemo should prioritize farming and building armor over approaching recklessly. The moment after Gnar returns from Mega to Mini is his weak point, and Teemo should look to trade then and when Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down. In the mid game, control routes with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. Teemo is fragile, so don't stand on the front line in late-game front-to-back fights.
Gnar.teamfight: Before a fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap along Gnar's approach and retreat routes and around objectives. Avoid standing with your back to a wall or in narrow terrain where Gnar R GNAR! can knock you into a wall. Once the fight starts, apply poison with basic attacks from the back line, and look for a chance to fight with your team just after Mega Gnar returns to Mini Gnar.
Gnar.watch: Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss slows you, and Mini Gnar's boomerang can hit you on its return, so move out of its path. Create distance when Gnar transforms into Mega Gnar, and don't stand with your back to a wall where Gnar R GNAR! can knock and stun you. Teemo Q Blinding Dart only blocks basic attacks, so don't rely on it to dodge Gnar's abilities.

Gwen.build: Early on, hold out with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. Build magic resistance first against Gwen's main damage, but manage your distance and angle too, since resistance can't block the true damage at the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Gwen.combo: Wait in a bush while stealthed with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then ambush with a basic attack to apply Teemo E Toxic Shot. When Gwen starts a retaliatory basic attack, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart, land one or two basic attacks, then retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish her off, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along Gwen's retreat path.
Gwen.escape: The moment after you make Gwen use E Skip 'n Slash is your chance to close the gap and trade. Don't force an engage through the slow from Gwen R Needlework; avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! and manage your distance with Teemo W Move Quick.
Gwen.fight: Before Gwen builds stacks for Q Snip Snip!, land one basic attack carrying Teemo E Toxic Shot from outside her attack range, then back off. Right after Gwen uses E Skip 'n Slash, you'll have a chance to adjust your distance, but use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when she starts a retaliatory basic attack and don't stay close for long.
Gwen.laning: Early on, keep your distance so Gwen can't land basic attacks on you, and use Teemo E Toxic Shot for brief poke. If you've pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes first to prepare for a gank. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, don't waste Teemo Q Blinding Dart from outside the mist.
Gwen.teamfight: Place Teemo R Noxious Trap in advance around objectives where a fight is expected and along Gwen's approach and retreat routes. Once the team fight starts, attack from the back line with basic attacks carrying Teemo E Toxic Shot. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, don't use Teemo Q Blinding Dart from outside the mist. Keep enough distance to avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals true damage, so move to the side to avoid the center when Gwen E Skip 'n Slash closes in. If Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active and Teemo is outside the mist, don't use Teemo Q Blinding Dart; wait. Also watch out for the slow and max-health damage from Gwen R Needlework.

Illaoi.build: Early on, hold out with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Illaoi's main damage is physical, so build armor first. Account for Illaoi's healing by applying Grievous Wounds with Executioner's Calling before planning to finish her off.
Illaoi.combo: Stealth in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then emerge and land an ambush basic attack, followed by Teemo Q Blinding Dart and one or two basic attacks. Don't stay close while taking damage from Illaoi's abilities; retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish her off, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart and basic attacks to apply poison, then throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along her retreat path.
Illaoi.escape: The window to engage is right after you dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit and make her use W Harsh Lesson. Go in, deal brief damage, then retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. If you can't fight while your spirit is pulled out, break the tether, and dodge the first tentacle after becoming the vessel.
Illaoi.fight: Stealth in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then emerge, apply poison with a basic attack, and trade briefly. Right after you make Illaoi use W Harsh Lesson, you'll have a chance to close the gap, but don't fight for long where there are tentacles. When she starts retaliating, retreat with Teemo W Move Quick.
Illaoi.laning: Keep the wave away from walls and last-hit from outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit's range. Repeat trades by applying Teemo E Toxic Shot's poison with one basic attack, then backing off. If you've pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes before applying pressure.
Illaoi.phase: In the mid game, control routes with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. Teemo is fragile, so don't stand on the front line in late-game front-to-back fights, and back away from an area where Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active.
Illaoi.teamfight: Before a fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap along the opponent's approach and retreat routes. Destroy tentacles if you can; if doing so is difficult, draw Illaoi away from the wall. Against Illaoi R Leap of Faith, spread out and wait out its duration while Teemo applies poison with basic attacks from the back line.
Illaoi.watch: Illaoi E Test of Spirit slows and marks you, so last-hit and dodge from outside its range. When Illaoi uses R Leap of Faith, don't group up; move away from the area with tentacles. Teemo Q Blinding Dart only disables basic attacks, so don't treat it as a way to block Illaoi's ability damage.

Irelia.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps. Irelia's damage is mainly physical and Teemo has low armor, so build armor first.
Irelia.combo: Stealth in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then emerge and land a basic attack. When Irelia retaliates with a basic attack, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart, land one or two more basic attacks carrying Teemo E Toxic Shot, then retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish her off, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along Irelia's retreat path.
Irelia.escape: The moment Irelia finishes chaining dashes after approaching with Q Bladesurge is your chance to regain your distance. If Irelia E Flawless Duet's stun is also down, use Teemo W Move Quick to find an angle and attack briefly.
Irelia.fight: After that, repeatedly land one basic attack carrying Teemo E Toxic Shot, then back off. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Irelia starts a retaliatory basic attack, then create distance with Teemo W Move Quick.
Irelia.laning: Use Teemo's range and Teemo E Toxic Shot to disrupt Irelia's farming. Don't leave a low-health minion between you and Irelia, and step back while minions are close to dying. If you've pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes before trading.
Irelia.phase: In the mid game, control routes with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. Teemo is fragile, so set traps beforehand and fight from the back in late-game front-to-back fights.
Irelia.teamfight: Before a fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap along Irelia's approach and retreat routes and around objectives. When the team fight breaks out, focus Irelia first and attack from the back line with basic attacks carrying Teemo E Toxic Shot. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart against Irelia's basic attacks, but dodge Irelia E Flawless Duet and Irelia R Vanguard's Edge separately.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain approaches by dashing through low-health minions, so create distance when minions are close to dying. Dodge the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet, and if you're trapped in Irelia R Vanguard's Edge's perimeter, wait until the blades disappear. Teemo Q Blinding Dart disables Irelia's basic attacks but can't stop her abilities.

Jax.build: The available information isn't enough to determine which item to buy first. Consider ways to reduce Jax's attack speed, and account for the physical damage from Jax Q Leap Strike and magic damage from Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike; don't focus on resistance to just one damage type.
Jax.combo: Wait in a bush while stealthed with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then emerge and apply poison with an ambush basic attack. After Counter Strike ends, when Jax retaliates with a basic attack, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart, briefly attack with basic attacks, then back off again.
Jax.escape: The moment after Jax Q Leap Strike and Jax E Counter Strike are down is your chance to regain your distance and poke.
Jax.fight: To keep Jax P Relentless Assault from building attack speed, land one brief basic attack at a time carrying Teemo E Toxic Shot, then back off. Poke again after Jax E Counter Strike ends, and use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Jax starts a retaliatory basic attack.
Jax.laning: Be careful not to give Jax Q Leap Strike a stepping stone near a minion wave. If you've pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes, then continue poking.
Jax.phase: In the mid game, control side lanes and routes with Teemo R Noxious Trap. In the late game, Teemo is fragile, so don't stand on the front line in team fights.
Jax.teamfight: Before a fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap along Jax's approach and retreat routes and around objectives. If Jax jumps in with E Counter Strike active, don't group up around him; wait outside stun range for its duration to end. Then apply poison with basic attacks from the back line, and use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Jax tries to deal damage with a basic attack.
Jax.watch: When Jax E Counter Strike is active, basic attacks are negated, and he can stun and deal damage when he reactivates it, so stop using basic attacks and move out of stun range. Jax Q Leap Strike can use a minion or ward as a stepping stone, so watch the allied minions in front of Jax and keep your distance.

Jayce.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Build magic resistance first against Jayce's main damage, but remember that it won't block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast. Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate deals max-health damage, so avoid choices that greatly increase only your health.
Jayce.combo: Stealth in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then emerge and land an ambush basic attack. When Jayce retaliates with a basic attack, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot's poison with one or two basic attacks, then retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish him off, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along Jayce's retreat path.
Jayce.escape: The moment after Jayce leaps in with hammer-form Jayce Q To the Skies! is your window to engage. If Jayce E Thundering Blow's knockback is also down, he's already used his means to push you away, so close the gap and fight. Use Teemo W Move Quick when backing off.
Jayce.fight: When Jayce has his cannon, dodge his long-range poke by moving side to side, land one basic attack carrying Teemo E Toxic Shot, then back off. The moment after Jayce leaps in with hammer-form Jayce Q To the Skies! is your chance to close the gap. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart just as Jayce is about to retaliate with a basic attack.
Jayce.laning: Early on, Jayce is strong, so farm defensively by moving side to side to dodge the straight line of Jayce Q Shock Blast. If health has been reduced, don't stay in lane recklessly; clear the wave, then return. If you've pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes, then continue trading.
Jayce.phase: Early on, Jayce is strong, so farm and hold on even if you fall behind instead of trying to catch up recklessly. From the mid game on, Teemo controls routes with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. Teemo is fragile, so don't stand on the front line in late-game team fights.
Jayce.teamfight: Before a fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in advance around objectives where a team fight is expected and along Jayce's approach and retreat routes. Once the fight starts, apply poison from the back line with basic attacks carrying Teemo E Toxic Shot. After Jayce leaps with hammer-form Jayce Q To the Skies!, look for an opening now that he has used his mobility ability.
Jayce.watch: When you see Jayce E Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q Shock Blast may follow, so move sideways out of its line. When Jayce has his hammer, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow. Teemo Q Blinding Dart only negates basic attacks, so don't use it to block Jayce's abilities.

Kayle.build: Early on, first hold out with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Kayle’s damage is mostly magic, and Teemo has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Kayle Q Radiant Blast reduces resistances, so dodge it to preserve the value of your magic resistance.
Kayle.combo: Become stealthed in a brush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then surprise Kayle with a basic attack that applies Teemo E Toxic Shot’s poison. When Kayle retaliates with a basic attack, hit her with Teemo Q Blinding Dart, land one or two more basic attacks, then disengage with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish her, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along her retreat path.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no skill that creates distance on her own, so the moment after you dodge Kayle Q Radiant Blast is your chance to close in. Kayle can use Kayle W Celestial Blessing for movement speed to escape, so close the gap with a brush ambush and use Teemo Q Blinding Dart to stop her retaliation during basic-attack trades. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is still available, deal damage after the invulnerability ends.
Kayle.fight: Ambush from a brush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then land a basic attack to apply Teemo E Toxic Shot’s poison. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Kayle starts a retaliatory basic attack. Dodge Kayle Q Radiant Blast and use Teemo W Move Quick to get out, repeating short trades.
Kayle.laning: Land one basic attack at a time to apply Teemo E Toxic Shot’s poison, then back off, and call your jungler so you can catch Kayle by surprise. If you’ve pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and brushes first to prepare for a gank.
Kayle.teamfight: Place Teemo R Noxious Trap ahead of time where a fight is expected and along Kayle’s approach and retreat paths. When the fight starts, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot’s poison with basic attacks from behind, and use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Kayle tries to land a basic attack. Save your damage while Kayle R Divine Judgment makes her invulnerable, and find a route from the flank to reach Kayle when your allies’ crowd control lands.
Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast slows and reduces magic resistance and armor, so dodge the direct hit before starting a trade. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals damage based on missing health, so don’t stay in a fight for long when your health is low. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don’t unload your damage; wait for the invulnerability to end.

Kled.build: Early on, survive with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Kled’s main damage is physical, and Teemo has low armor, so build armor first. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!.
Kled.combo: Hide in a brush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then surprise Kled with a basic attack, Teemo Q Blinding Dart, and one or two basic attacks, in that order, before disengaging with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish him, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart to block his retaliatory basic attack, land a basic attack that applies Teemo E Toxic Shot, then throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along Kled’s retreat path.
Kled.escape: A short window to go in opens after Kled misses Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope and uses Kled E Jousting. If Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is still available, he has another way to engage and escape, so don’t chase deep; look for an opening after he uses it and before it comes back.
Kled.fight: Hide in a brush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then surprise Kled with a basic attack that applies Teemo E Toxic Shot’s poison and trade briefly. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Kled starts retaliating with basic attacks, and use Teemo W Move Quick to escape if Kled tries to close in with Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope or Kled E Jousting. The poison damage will keep ticking, so you don’t need to stay and fight.
Kled.laning: Use your range to repeat trades where you apply Teemo E Toxic Shot’s poison with one basic attack and back off. If you’ve pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and brushes before pressuring him. If you’ve dismounted Kled, keep him away from minions that would let him build courage, and create distance if you can’t finish him.
Kled.phase: If Kled doesn’t get an early lead, he weakens as laning and the mid game progress. From the mid game onward, Teemo controls movement with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. Don’t stand in front during late-game front-to-front team fights with Teemo’s squishy body.
Kled.teamfight: If a fight is expected, place Teemo R Noxious Trap ahead of time on Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!’s approach and retreat paths, and secure vision on the flank. When Kled starts charging, hold your formation, and have Teemo apply Teemo E Toxic Shot’s poison with basic attacks from behind. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Kled W Violent Tendencies’ basic attacks become threatening.
Kled.watch: If you’re caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, use Teemo W Move Quick to create distance before you’re pulled in. Kled W Violent Tendencies’ fourth basic attack deals damage based on maximum health, so use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when he starts attacking to negate the basic attack, and don’t stay close for long. Teemo Q Blinding Dart can’t stop Kled’s abilities, so watch out for engages with Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!.

Nasus.build: Early on, survive with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, his main source of damage, deals physical damage, so build armor first.
Nasus.combo: Ambush from a brush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then come out and apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with a basic attack. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart just as Nasus tries to retaliate with Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, land one or two more basic attacks, then disengage with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish him, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along Nasus’s retreat path.
Nasus.escape: When Nasus W Wither is down, you have a good window to go in. Nasus has no skill that creates distance on his own, so pressure him then, using Teemo Q Blinding Dart to block Nasus Q Siphoning Strike.
Nasus.fight: Early on, pressure Nasus when he tries to last-hit with Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, repeating trades where you land one basic attack with Teemo E Toxic Shot and back off. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Nasus retaliates with a basic attack, then create distance with Teemo W Move Quick. Don’t force a close fight if Nasus W Wither has caught you or Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active.
Nasus.laning: Pressure Nasus from early on to make it difficult for him to stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, but don’t push the lane all the way under his turret. Let the lane come toward you so it’s easier to harass his last hits and call for a jungle gank. If you’ve pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and brushes, then continue trading.
Nasus.phase: As time passes, Nasus Q Siphoning Strike stacks up and the matchup gets worse for Teemo. In the mid game, control routes with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap; in the late game, don’t put squishy Teemo on the frontline.
Nasus.teamfight: Before a fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap on Nasus’s approach and retreat paths and around objectives. When the fight starts, attack from behind with Teemo E Toxic Shot and keep your distance; don’t meet Nasus head-on while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active.
Nasus.watch: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike empowers his basic attack and becomes more threatening as it stacks, so use Teemo Q Blinding Dart to negate that attack when trading back. Nasus W Wither reduces movement and attack speed, so be careful not to get caught alone in its range. Nasus R Fury of the Sands makes him stronger, so unless you have a clear advantage, avoid fighting and let its duration run out.

Ornn.build: Since Teemo has no mobility spell, consider prioritizing tenacity over resistances to account for being chained by Ornn W Bellows Breath, Ornn E Searing Charge, and Ornn R Call of the Forge God. Ornn deals both physical and magic damage, so don’t lean too heavily into just one resistance.
Ornn.combo: Hide in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then ambush Ornn with a basic attack to apply Teemo E Toxic Shot. When Ornn tries to retaliate with an empowered basic attack, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart, then land one or two basic attacks and retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish him off, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap onto Ornn’s escape route.
Ornn.escape: Even after Ornn E Searing Charge is down, don’t push too far if Ornn R Call of the Forge God is still available. In particular, use the window after Ornn casts R and before it returns to pressure him, but fight away from the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and from walls.
Ornn.fight: Repeat trades where you land one basic attack with Teemo E Toxic Shot and then back off. Teemo Q Blinding Dart can’t block Ornn W Bellows Breath, so use Q when Ornn starts an empowered basic attack. If only one of Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God is down, keep your distance and watch for the remaining engage tool.
Ornn.laning: Early on, whittle Ornn down with your range and Teemo E Toxic Shot, but don’t fight near walls or the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture. If Ornn tries to forge an item, approach and attack to interrupt him. If you’ve pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes before continuing to trade.
Ornn.phase: In the mid game, control movement with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. In the late game, Teemo has a hard time standing in a head-on team fight, while Ornn’s items and his allies’ masterwork upgrades add up, so use your early lead to pressure him sooner.
Ornn.teamfight: Before a fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap along Ornn’s engage and escape routes and around objectives. Once the team fight starts, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with basic attacks from the backline while avoiding the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath and the path of Ornn R Call of the Forge God.
Ornn.watch: Ornn E Searing Charge can knock you up near walls or the pillar left by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, so retreat toward open ground. If the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, keep your distance until the effect ends. When Ornn R Call of the Forge God begins, move out of the line between Ornn and the elemental, then avoid the elemental’s return path after it passes.

Pantheon.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Pantheon’s main damage is physical and Teemo has relatively low armor, so build armor first. If the enemy team has an assassin, move Zhonya’s Hourglass up between your core items.
Pantheon.combo: Hide in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then step out and land a basic attack. Hit Pantheon with Teemo Q Blinding Dart when he starts a retaliatory basic attack. Follow up with one or two basic attacks to apply Teemo E Toxic Shot, then retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish him off, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap onto Pantheon’s escape route.
Pantheon.escape: Once Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, you have a chance to close the gap and trade. If Pantheon R Grand Starfall is down too, check his remaining mobility tools before engaging.
Pantheon.fight: Ambush from a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, land a basic attack, then use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Pantheon starts a retaliatory basic attack. If Pantheon W Shield Vault is still available, keep your distance first.
Pantheon.laning: Stand behind minions against Pantheon Q Comet Spear so they take the hit first and you receive reduced damage. Apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with one basic attack, then back off without giving Pantheon W Shield Vault range. If you’ve pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes, then continue trading.
Pantheon.phase: In the mid game, control movement with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. In the late game, use traps you’ve placed ahead of time instead of facing Pantheon directly as his impact falls off.
Pantheon.teamfight: Before a team fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap along Pantheon’s engage and escape routes and around objectives. Once the fight starts, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with basic attacks from the backline and stay out of Pantheon W Shield Vault range. If you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets you directly and stuns, so be careful not to enter its range. Teemo Q Blinding Dart only negates basic attacks, so don’t use it preemptively to block Pantheon W Shield Vault or Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front, so wait for it to end or attack from the side.

Poppy.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Build armor first to prepare for the physical damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock and Poppy E Heroic Charge.
Poppy.combo: Hide in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then step out for an ambush basic attack. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Poppy starts a retaliatory basic attack. Land one or two more basic attacks to apply the poison from Teemo E Toxic Shot, then disengage with Teemo W Move Quick. If you can finish her off, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap onto Poppy’s escape route.
Poppy.escape: Approach right after baiting Poppy into using E Heroic Charge. If Poppy starts charging R Keeper’s Verdict, dodge to the side first to avoid being knocked away, then reassess the distance. When escaping, use Teemo W Move Quick’s active effect to increase your movement speed.
Poppy.fight: Keep your distance to avoid getting caught by Poppy E Heroic Charge. Apply the poison from Teemo E Toxic Shot with one basic attack, then back off. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Poppy starts a retaliatory basic attack, but remember that Blinding Dart can’t block her ability damage. The moment Poppy E Heroic Charge is down is your chance to close the gap and attack again.
Poppy.laning: Whittle Poppy down with your range and Teemo E Toxic Shot, but don’t trade with your back to a wall or narrow passage. When you can safely step on the buckler dropped by Poppy P Iron Ambassador, destroy it first to prevent her from gaining a shield. If you’ve pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes before continuing to poke.
Poppy.phase: In the mid game, play the side lanes and control chokepoints with Teemo R Noxious Trap. You’re fragile in late-game head-on team fights, so place traps beforehand and attack from the backline.
Poppy.teamfight: Place Teemo R Noxious Trap ahead of time where fights are likely and around objectives. Block Poppy’s engage and escape routes with traps, then apply the poison from Teemo E Toxic Shot with basic attacks from the backline once the fight starts. If Poppy starts charging R Keeper’s Verdict, move out from directly in front of her.
Poppy.watch: Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns if it hits a wall, so stand in open ground rather than with your back to a wall. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you, leave the area before the second explosion. If you see Poppy charging R Keeper’s Verdict, dodge to the side from the front.

Quinn.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Quinn deals mostly physical damage and Teemo has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Quinn.combo: Hide in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then ambush Quinn with a basic attack to apply the poison from Teemo E Toxic Shot. When Quinn starts a retaliatory basic attack, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart, land one or two more basic attacks, then retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish her off, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap onto Quinn’s escape route.
Quinn.escape: The moment Quinn E Vault is down is your window to close the gap. Don’t force an engage before then; approach with Teemo W Move Quick after she uses E.
Quinn.fight: While Quinn P Harrier’s mark is absent, apply the poison from Teemo E Toxic Shot with a basic attack and back off. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Quinn starts a retaliatory basic attack to negate it. The moment Quinn E Vault is down, look for a chance to close the gap with Teemo W Move Quick.
Quinn.laning: Back off while marked, and farm or trade while unmarked. Position yourself behind the minion line to find an angle to dodge Quinn Q Blinding Assault. If you’ve pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes to prepare for a gank, then continue trading.
Quinn.phase: Early on, Teemo should avoid Quinn’s marked poke and keep trades short. In the mid game, control the map with side lanes and mushrooms. In the late game, don’t take the frontline in head-on team fights, since you’re fragile.
Quinn.teamfight: Before a fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap along Quinn’s flanking and escape routes and around objectives. Once the fight starts, apply the poison from Teemo E Toxic Shot with basic attacks from the backline, and use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Quinn retaliates with a basic attack.
Quinn.watch: If Quinn P Harrier marks you, move outside basic attack range so you don’t get hit by her empowered basic attack. Stand behind minions against Quinn Q Blinding Assault so a minion is the first target, and don’t force an engage while Quinn E Vault is available. Teemo Q Blinding Dart negates Quinn’s basic attacks, but it can’t block Quinn Q or E.

Renekton.build: Start by playing safe with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Renekton’s main damage is physical and Teemo has low armor, so build armor first. The empowered recast of Renekton E Slice and Dice reduces armor, so also position yourself to dodge his dash.
Renekton.combo: Prepare to hide with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare in a bush, then step out and apply the poison from Teemo E Toxic Shot with a basic attack. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Renekton starts a retaliatory basic attack, land one or two more basic attacks, then disengage with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish him off, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart and a poison-applyng basic attack, then throw Teemo R Noxious Trap onto Renekton’s escape route.
Renekton.escape: The moment Renekton E Slice and Dice is used is your chance to engage; if he also used it to disengage, he’s even more vulnerable. If Renekton W Ruthless Predator and his Q, W, and E are all down, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart to absorb his remaining basic attacks while taking a short trade. When backing off after taking his combo, retreat in a direction with no target for Renekton to dash through.
Renekton.fight: When Renekton has no Fury, trade by applying the poison from Teemo E Toxic Shot with a basic attack and backing off. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Renekton starts a retaliatory basic attack, then poke again after Renekton has used Q Cull the Meek, W Ruthless Predator, and E Slice and Dice.
Renekton.laning: Poke Renekton with your range and Teemo E Toxic Shot when he steps in front of minions to build Fury. Avoid standing in or behind a minion wave so it can’t serve as a platform for Renekton E Slice and Dice. If you’ve pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes first, then trade.
Renekton.phase: In the mid game, avoid giving up kills while you scale, and control chokepoints with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. You’re fragile in late-game head-on team fights, so don’t stand in front.
Renekton.teamfight: Before a fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap along the enemy’s engage and escape routes and around objectives. Once the fight starts, apply the poison from Teemo E Toxic Shot with basic attacks from the backline, and keep your distance based on Renekton’s engage and Fury.
Renekton.watch: When Renekton P Reign of Anger is around half full or higher, watch for empowered abilities, and especially stay out of range of the stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Renekton E Slice and Dice unlocks a second dash if it hits a minion, so don’t stand in or behind a minion wave. Teemo Q Blinding Dart only negates basic attacks, so don’t expect it to stop Renekton’s abilities.

Rumble.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Rumble’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on your max health, so avoid relying on health stacking alone.
Rumble.combo: Hide in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then step out and land a basic attack. Follow with Teemo Q Blinding Dart and one or two basic attacks, then retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. Teemo Q Blinding Dart negates Rumble’s basic attacks but can’t block Rumble Q Flamespitter, so don’t stay close for long. To finish him off, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart, a basic attack to apply poison, then Teemo R Noxious Trap on Rumble’s escape route.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility spell, but account for the movement speed from Rumble W Scrap Shield and the slow from Rumble E Electro Harpoon when engaging. If Rumble has already used W Scrap Shield and you dodged E Electro Harpoon, you have a chance to pressure him. If the first harpoon hits you, don’t engage; use Teemo W Move Quick to create distance before the second harpoon arrives.
Rumble.fight: Apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with a basic attack, then back off so you don’t stay in Rumble Q Flamespitter’s range for long. If Rumble activates W Scrap Shield, hold off briefly to let the shield pass, then attack again.
Rumble.laning: Hide in a bush beforehand with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then ambush Rumble with a basic attack as he walks forward. Since the poison damage continues, don’t keep fighting inside Rumble Q Flamespitter; repeat trades where you hit once and back off. If you’ve pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes, then continue trading.
Rumble.phase: Early on, Teemo can gain an advantage with magic damage because Rumble has low magic resistance, but Teemo also needs to watch out for Rumble’s magic damage. From the mid game on, control movement with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. You’re fragile in late-game head-on team fights, so don’t stand in front; use traps you placed ahead of time.
Rumble.teamfight: Place Teemo R Noxious Trap first where a fight is likely and cover Rumble’s engage and escape routes. Once the fight starts, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with basic attacks from the backline and avoid staying in Rumble Q Flamespitter for long. Before an objective fight, place traps around the area.
Rumble.watch: Watch for Rumble E Electro Harpoon from the first shot. Rumble Q Flamespitter is more likely to hit you at close range, so keep your distance as Rumble walks toward you.

Sett.build: Play safe early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Sett’s main damage is physical and Teemo has low armor, so build armor first.
Sett.combo: Hide in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then step out for an ambush basic attack. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Sett retaliates with a basic attack, land one or two more basic attacks, then retreat with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish him off, apply poison with Blinding Dart and a basic attack, then throw Teemo R Noxious Trap onto Sett’s escape route.
Sett.escape: When Sett E Facebreaker is down, you have a window to engage without worrying about its stun.
Sett.fight: Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart to block Sett when he starts a basic attack, land a basic attack with Teemo E Toxic Shot, then create distance with Teemo W Move Quick. Immediately after dealing damage, watch for Sett W Haymaker and wait before moving in again.
Sett.laning: Keep your range and repeat trades where you apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with one basic attack and back off. If Sett walks toward you, retreat before the movement speed from Sett Q Knuckle Down kicks in. If you’ve pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes, then continue to poke.
Sett.phase: In the mid game, control chokepoints with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. You’re fragile in late-game head-on team fights, so don’t stand in front.
Sett.teamfight: Place Teemo R Noxious Trap ahead of time where a fight is likely to block Sett’s engage and escape routes. Once the fight starts, apply poison with basic attacks from the backline, and stand overlapping with an ally while accounting for where Sett R The Show Stopper could grab and throw you.
Sett.watch: If Sett walks toward you with the movement speed from Q Knuckle Down, back away before he can grab you. Sett E Facebreaker stuns if there are enemies on both sides of him, so don’t stand between Sett and a minion wave. Sett W Haymaker grows stronger after he takes damage, so create distance after attacking and dodge sideways from the center of its aim when he casts it.

Shen.build: The material doesn’t specify a particular item to buy first, so there’s no item recommendation. Prioritize tenacity to counter Shen E Shadow Dash’s taunt, and consider both physical and magic damage when choosing resistances.
Shen.combo: Wait hidden in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then emerge and apply poison with a basic attack. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart in response to Shen’s retaliatory basic attack. If there is no Shen W Spirit’s Refuge, land more basic attacks, then escape with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish him, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along his retreat path.
Shen.escape: Right after Shen E Shadow Dash misses, Teemo has a window to engage and trade back. Shen R Stand United is also a way for him to reposition, so track whether both abilities are available if you’re aiming for a kill.
Shen.fight: Right after Shen E Shadow Dash misses, stay at range and use a basic attack to apply Teemo E Toxic Shot. When Shen starts a retaliatory basic attack, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart. If Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is placed, stop basic attacking and keep your distance.
Shen.laning: Take lane control by repeatedly applying poison with one basic attack, then backing off. If you’ve pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes before continuing to poke. Keeping Shen occupied with minions can make him lose ground when he uses Shen R Stand United to affect another lane.
Shen.phase: Use Teemo’s strong early game against melee opponents to take lane control. In the late game, Teemo can’t easily stand in a head-on team fight, so prepare the fight location in advance.
Shen.teamfight: Before a fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap along approach and retreat routes and around objectives. When the fight starts, apply poison with basic attacks from the back, and don’t basic attack inside Shen W Spirit’s Refuge. Alert your team immediately if you see Shen channeling Shen R Stand United.
Shen.watch: If Shen E Shadow Dash taunts you, you’ll be hit by basic attacks empowered by Shen Q Twilight Assault, so dodge the dash first. Also sidestep the path of his Spirit Blade as it returns to Shen to reduce the damage you take.
