Singed.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Singed’s main damage is magic and Teemo has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Singed.combo: Hide in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then emerge and ambush him with a basic attack, followed by Teemo Q Blinding Dart and one or two basic attacks. Singed’s damage is ability focused, so Teemo Q Blinding Dart can’t stop Singed Q Poison Trail or Singed E Fling. Apply poison, then escape with Teemo W Move Quick. If you can finish him, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along his retreat path.
Singed.escape: Singed has no ability that creates distance on its own, so the window to approach comes after he uses Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling. Conversely, if the adhesive has been laid down or you’ve entered Singed E Fling’s range, use Teemo W Move Quick to get out of the poison trail and reposition at a safer distance.
Singed.fight: Don’t fight for long while following Singed Q Poison Trail; use Teemo W Move Quick to get out of the trail. Look for a chance to approach again after Singed uses Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling.
Singed.laning: Pressure Singed with one basic attack at a time early on to force him to recall. If you’ve pushed the lane, plant Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes before continuing to trade. Don’t step into Singed Q Poison Trail or an area covered by Singed W Mega Adhesive while chasing him.
Singed.phase: Singed becomes hard to kill once he has his core items, so manage side lanes and choke points with Teemo R Noxious Trap in the mid game. Teemo is fragile in late-game head-on team fights, so lay traps in advance and fight from the back.
Singed.teamfight: Before a fight, plant Teemo R Noxious Trap along Singed’s approach and retreat routes and around objectives. If Singed rushes in, use the traps’ slow to hinder him. Rather than chasing him to the end, apply poison with basic attacks from the back and attack his allies.
Singed.watch: Singed Q Poison Trail leaves damage where he passes, so don’t chase through the poison even if his health looks low. Go around areas covered by Singed W Mega Adhesive, and account for being thrown behind Singed if you’re hit by Singed E Fling when positioning. While Singed R Insanity Potion is active, his poison also reduces healing, so get out of the trail.

Sion.build: Use Cloth Armor to endure the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Sion’s main damage is physical and Teemo has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces your armor, so keep dodging it even after you’ve completed items.
Sion.combo: Wait hidden in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then emerge with an ambush basic attack. When Sion starts a counterattack with a basic attack, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart, land one or two more basic attacks empowered by Teemo E Toxic Shot, then escape with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish him, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along his retreat path.
Sion.escape: After dodging or forcing Sion to use Sion Q Decimating Smash early, attack briefly and back off. Teemo has no ability to escape on his own, so don’t fight for long within range of Sion’s slow or stun.
Sion.fight: When Sion charges Sion Q Decimating Smash, use Teemo W Move Quick to sidestep the attack. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Sion starts a counterattack with a basic attack, then land a basic attack empowered by Teemo E Toxic Shot before backing off. Teemo Q Blinding Dart can’t stop Sion’s abilities, so don’t use it in place of dodging Sion Q Decimating Smash.
Sion.laning: Against Sion, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot’s poison with one basic attack at a time, then create distance again. If you’ve pushed the lane, first place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes to prepare for a gank. Sion gains maximum health as he keeps killing minions, so disrupt his farming or use that time to gain an advantage in another lane.
Sion.phase: In the mid game, manage side lanes and control choke points and the enemy jungle’s routes with Teemo R Noxious Trap. Teemo is fragile in late-game head-on team fights, so place traps beforehand and attack from the back.
Sion.teamfight: Place Teemo R Noxious Trap in advance around objectives where a fight is expected and along Sion’s approach and retreat routes. When the fight starts, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot’s poison with basic attacks from the back. Don’t stay where Sion falls; reposition until Sion P Glory in Death ends.
Sion.watch: When Sion charges Sion Q Decimating Smash, sidestep to avoid the knock-up and stun instead of retreating straight back. Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught also travels mostly in a straight line, so avoid narrow paths and sidestep. Sion E Roar of the Slayer slows and reduces armor, so watch out for follow-up attacks if it hits you. When Sion falls, Sion P Glory in Death brings him back, so immediately create distance.

Skarner.build: Use Null-Magic Mantle to endure the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first to account for the damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. If you need a way to remove Skarner R Impale’s suppression, decide in advance whether to build Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar.
Skarner.combo: Hide in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then emerge and apply Teemo E Toxic Shot’s poison with an ambush basic attack. When Skarner is about to counterattack with an empowered basic attack, hit him with Teemo Q Blinding Dart, land one or two basic attacks, then escape with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish him, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along his retreat path.
Skarner.escape: Only close the gap to attack right after you’ve made Skarner use Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. After Skarner R Impale suppresses you, you can’t escape with Teemo W Move Quick, so leave yourself a route to circle out of its short range before approaching.
Skarner.fight: Right after Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down, you have a chance to close the gap and trade. Use basic attacks empowered by Teemo E Toxic Shot to hit and back off. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Skarner is about to land an empowered basic attack from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval.
Skarner.laning: Repeatedly apply Teemo E Toxic Shot’s poison with one basic attack on the approaching Skarner, then back off. Don’t stand with your back to a wall because of Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact, and use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when he starts a counterattack with a basic attack. If you’ve pushed the lane, first plant Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes, then continue to trade.
Skarner.phase: Skarner deals more damage as he builds tank items, so it’s important to gain early jungle control and secure objectives to delay his item timings. In the mid game, control routes with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. In the late game, don’t stand in front with Teemo’s fragile body.
Skarner.teamfight: Before a fight, plant Teemo R Noxious Trap along Skarner’s approach and retreat routes and around objectives. When the fight starts, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot’s poison with basic attacks from the back, and hit Skarner with Teemo Q Blinding Dart when he uses an empowered basic attack from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval. Skarner R Impale drags its targets regardless of terrain, so don’t stand close to the edges of the Dragon or Baron pit.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact dashes through terrain, and if he catches you and hits a wall, you’re stunned. Don’t stand with your back to a wall; keep your distance in open space and stay out of the short range of Skarner R Impale.

Trundle.build: Use Cloth Armor to endure the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Trundle’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Trundle R Subjugate deals damage based on maximum health and reduces resistances, so manage your distance instead of relying on stacking more health or resistances alone.
Trundle.combo: Hide in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then ambush him with a basic attack to apply Teemo E Toxic Shot. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Trundle starts a counterattack with a basic attack, land one or two more basic attacks, then escape with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish him, attack after blinding him and throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along his retreat path.
Trundle.escape: Engage after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and the duration of Trundle W Frozen Domain has run out. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so take that opportunity in open terrain. If the pillar blocks your escape route, don’t engage; immediately sidestep.
Trundle.fight: Wait hidden in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then emerge and repeat short trades: apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with a basic attack, then back off. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Trundle starts a counterattack with a basic attack to neutralize it, then create distance with Teemo W Move Quick. Fight again after leaving Trundle W Frozen Domain, and engage in open terrain when Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down.
Trundle.laning: Use your range and Teemo E Toxic Shot to poke with one basic attack at a time, but account for Trundle P King’s Tribute healing him whenever a nearby unit dies. If you’ve lowered his health, don’t let the lane drag on; take an advantage immediately or push the lane to force him to recall. If you’ve pushed the lane, plant Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes before continuing to trade.
Trundle.phase: In the late game, Teemo is too fragile to stand on the front line in a head-on team fight, so place traps in advance and fight from the back.
Trundle.teamfight: Before an objective fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap along approach and retreat routes. When the fight starts, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with basic attacks from the back. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, create distance or attack another target. Don’t fight in narrow paths where Trundle E Pillar of Ice can easily block your escape.
Trundle.watch: Trundle’s attack speed increases on Trundle W Frozen Domain, so don’t fight there; move out and let its duration run out. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks narrow escape routes and slows you, so immediately sidestep when the pillar appears. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, your resistances are reduced and Trundle becomes tougher, so create distance.

Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to endure the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Tryndamere.combo: Ambush Tryndamere from a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, applying Teemo E Toxic Shot with a surprise basic attack. When he counterattacks with a basic attack, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart, attack once or twice more, then escape with Teemo W Move Quick. To finish him, throw Teemo R Noxious Trap along his retreat path, but create distance first if Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active.
Tryndamere.escape: Right after you’ve made Tryndamere use Tryndamere E Spinning Slash, you have a window to close the gap and attack. If Tryndamere W Mocking Shout hits you, your attack damage is reduced, so don’t immediately start a basic attack fight. When retreating, use Teemo W Move Quick and move while facing Tryndamere to avoid the slow.
Tryndamere.fight: Poke Tryndamere with basic attacks empowered by Teemo E Toxic Shot and back off before he hits minions to build Fury. Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Tryndamere starts a counterattack with a basic attack to neutralize it. Right after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, you have a chance to close the gap and attack again.
Tryndamere.laning: From the early game, repeatedly apply poison with one basic attack and back off to disrupt Tryndamere’s last hits and Fury buildup. If Tryndamere hits minions to build Fury, treat it as a sign that he wants to engage and create distance first. If you’ve pushed the lane, plant Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and bushes before continuing to trade.
Tryndamere.phase: In the mid game, control choke points with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. Teemo is fragile in late-game head-on team fights, so don’t stand in front and place traps in advance.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Plant Teemo R Noxious Trap in advance around objectives where a fight is expected and along Tryndamere’s approach and retreat routes. When the fight starts, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with basic attacks from the back, and hit Tryndamere with Teemo Q Blinding Dart when he basic attacks. While Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, create distance and attack after it ends.
Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is a dash, and critical strikes reduce its cooldown, so don’t chase him where there are many minions. Tryndamere W Mocking Shout slows you when your back is turned as you retreat, so face Tryndamere while backing away. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, he can’t be killed, so create distance and let its duration run out.

Udyr.combo: Hide in a bush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, then emerge and apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with an ambush basic attack. The moment Udyr is about to counterattack with an empowered basic attack, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart, attack once or twice more, then escape with Teemo W Move Quick.
Udyr.escape: Right after you’ve made Udyr use Udyr E Blazing Stampede, you have a window to create distance or counterattack. If you’ve already been stunned once, use the period when the same target can’t be stunned again for a while to escape.
Udyr.fight: Lower Udyr’s health with basic attacks empowered by Teemo E Toxic Shot and back off before he gets close. Pressure him again once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone, but save Teemo W Move Quick to respond to Udyr E Blazing Stampede.
Udyr.laning: Udyr appears from the jungle to gank, so place Teemo R Noxious Trap at jungle entrances and key paths to watch his movements. Don’t push forward when Udyr is out of sight, and poke with one basic attack at a time from a safe distance.
Udyr.phase: In the mid game, control choke points with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. Teemo is fragile in late-game head-on team fights, so make use of traps placed in advance.
Udyr.teamfight: Before a fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap along Udyr’s approach and retreat routes and around objectives. When the fight starts, apply poison with basic attacks from the back, and time Teemo Q Blinding Dart to Udyr’s basic attacks. Rather than forcing attacks on Udyr once Udyr W Iron Mantle and defensive items make him tanky, target a weaker enemy behind him first.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede increases his movement speed so he can approach and stun you, so create distance right after he activates the stance. Block Udyr Q Wilding Claw’s empowered basic attacks with Teemo Q Blinding Dart, but Udyr R Wingborne Storm’s area damage and slow can’t be blocked by blinding, so get out of it.

Urgot.build: Urgot’s main damage is physical, and Teemo has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to hold on early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Urgot P Echoing Flames scales with maximum health, so don’t rely on choices that only increase your health.
Urgot.combo: Use Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare to become stealthed in the brush, then come out with a basic attack, followed by Teemo Q Blinding Dart and one or two more basic attacks. Don’t stay near Urgot for long; use Teemo W Move Quick to get away. To finish, use Teemo Q Blinding Dart followed by a basic attack to apply poison, then throw Teemo R Noxious Trap where Urgot will retreat.
Urgot.escape: Your chance to go in comes right after you’ve made Urgot use his only mobility tool, Urgot E Disdain. Attack briefly then use Teemo W Move Quick to create distance again. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge has already hit you, its heavy slow makes it hard to walk away, so don’t treat that situation as an opportunity to engage.
Urgot.fight: Urgot P Echoing Flames punishes you more the longer you stay nearby, so trade briefly and move out of range. If Urgot approaches with Urgot W Purge active, use Teemo W Move Quick to create distance. Look for a chance to close in and attack only right after Urgot E Disdain is down.
Urgot.laning: From outside Urgot’s short range, repeatedly poke with one basic attack empowered by Teemo E Toxic Shot, then back away. Teemo Q Blinding Dart disables basic attacks but does not stop abilities, so don’t use it to block Urgot E Disdain or Urgot Q Corrosive Charge. If you’ve pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and brush, then keep poking.
Urgot.phase: In the mid game, control paths with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. In late-game head-on team fights, Teemo is fragile, so don’t stand in front and fight for long.
Urgot.teamfight: Before a fight, place Teemo R Noxious Trap along Urgot’s engage and retreat routes. Once the fight starts, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot’s poison with basic attacks from the backline and keep your distance. Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so stand behind your frontline to reduce the chance it hits you directly.
Urgot.watch: If you’re caught by Urgot E Disdain, you may take damage following the stun and charge, so keep your distance from the start. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits you, it slows you heavily and makes you a target for Urgot W Purge, so dodge it as it comes in. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of Urgot’s range before your health reaches the execute threshold.

Use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Volibear starts a retaliatory basic attack, and use Teemo W Move Quick to create distance after applying poison. If Volibear W Frenzied Maul could heal him significantly, only go back in when you can finish him for sure.

Once the fight starts, attack from the backline with basic attacks empowered by Teemo E Toxic Shot, and use Teemo Q Blinding Dart when Volibear attacks with a basic attack. If Volibear is stacking Volibear P The Relentless Storm by hitting minions or monsters, don’t take a fight while he is in that state.
Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash increases his movement speed as he approaches and stuns with an empowered basic attack. When Volibear activates Q, let time pass from outside basic attack range, and sidestep when the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter appears to avoid its damage and slow. When Volibear R Stormbringer is available, don’t stay under your turret just because health is low; retreat farther inward.

Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, he briefly has no way to knock you up, so ambush him from the brush with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with a basic attack, then back away. If Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks your way, save Teemo Q Blinding Dart and go around it or use Q after the wall disappears.

Repeat trades where you apply Teemo E Toxic Shot with one basic attack and then back away. If you’ve pushed the lane, place Teemo R Noxious Trap in the river and brush first to guard against ganks.
Yasuo.phase: In the mid game, control paths with side lanes and Teemo R Noxious Trap. In the late game, Teemo is fragile, so don’t stand on the front line in a head-on team fight.

After hitting Q twice, he can knock you up with a tornado and follow with Yasuo R Last Breath, so watch for the sound and effects and move out of its line in advance. If there are many minions, Yasuo can use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to close in, so manage your distance more carefully.
